candidates.statement: Postgres connection pool exhaustion on the order service: save_order spans show pool size 5 with 0 idle and fail with DependencyUnavailable after ~2s, causing order 503s, order ReadTimeouts, and gateway checkout 502s.
candidates.uncertainty: No postgres server-side metrics or pool wait-time series; pool saturation inferred from span attributes only.

report.explanation: Traces show every checkout failing at postgres.save_order with pool size 5, idle 0, and DependencyUnavailable after ~2s, propagating to order 503/ReadTimeout and gateway 502s; gateway metrics show 16 502s and p95 ~2425ms on /v1/checkout. Consistent with db-pool-exhaustion; pool metrics would confirm.
missing_evidence: Postgres connection pool metrics (active/idle/waiting) for the order service over the incident window
Postgres server-side logs or slow-query data confirming saturation vs. server unavailability
